description: Mechanical keyboard and mouse sounds for every keystroke and click, with customizable sound packs.
notes: Uses the official Inno Setup installer as an archive; Scoop extracts its payload without running the installer.

The installer’s custom migration and registry steps are not executed during extraction. An existing Mechvibes 2 installation is not removed automatically; uninstall it manually before using this version if both copies would run at the same time.
Settings and custom sound packs are stored under %APPDATA%\Mechvibes, outside the Scoop app directory; this manifest does not redirect that data to D:.
Because the installer is extracted rather than run, its mechvibes:// protocol registration and optional startup task are not applied.
